messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: High 95th latency on generation-service (us-east-1) > 3s. Error rate rising, frontend 502/503s increasing. See alerts: https://alerts.redwood.internal/alert/8872. Paging oncall.
Jordan (oncall): I'm on it. Starting with recent deploys and batcher metrics. @ops-bot can you dump pod statuses + recent evictions?
ops-bot: kubectl get pods -n generation — returned:```gen-srv-1 Running  2/2  12h
gen-srv-2 CrashLoopBackOff  0/2 5m
gen-batcher-0 Running  1/1  3d```Recent events: `kvcache eviction` spikes at 2026-03-15T01:11Z.
Jordan (oncall): seeing the CrashLoopBackOff on gen-srv-2. Pulling logs now.
Jordan (oncall): logs:```2026-03-15T01:10:12 ERROR kv_cache.cpp:245 KVCache::get: miss seq=8732
2026-03-15T01:10:15 WARN batcher.cpp:98 batch overflow, dropping request
2026-03-15T01:10:16 ERROR http_server.cpp:412 downstream 503 returned to client```Looks like KV cache churn causing batcher pressure.
Priya: this aligns with the model split rollout we did ~00:45 — new variant has larger embedding keys, higher KV footprint. Might be causing faster eviction.
Samir: mitigation plan: 1) reduce batcher concurrency to limit inflight KV lookups; 2) pin traffic to older variant until cache adjustments; 3) alert owner for model split. We can do (1) quickly via `redwoodctl` config.
Samir: run: `redwoodctl runtime update generation-service --set batcher.max_concurrency=8` (defaults were 32).
Jordan (oncall): applying now. `redwoodctl runtime update ...` -> accepted. Rolling patch across us-east-1 pool.
ops-bot: Patch applied to pool us-east-1. Rolling restart started for gen-batcher pods.
Jordan (oncall): observing metrics — p95 down from 3.8s -> 1.2s over last 6m. Error rate falling. Good mitigation.
Tess: tagging customer impact: Support ticket spikes for accounts acme-corp and finlytics at ~01:12 UTC. Roughly 120k requests affected, ~0.8% error rate of total traffic. I'll open a customer-impact doc.
Miguel: nice mitigation. Next: schedule post-incident review, collect timeline, and assign action owners. Priya can you own postmortem writeup?
Priya: I can. I'll draft timeline and RCA. Proposed postmortem time: Thu 15:00 UTC. Invite: eng-sre, eng-runtime, product reliability. Link I'll use: https://docs.redwood.internal/incidents/1778881110-draft
Ava (eng): I'll take runbook updates — need to add a checklist for model-split KV footprint estimation + a pre-rollout memory check.
Samir: I'll own root cause deep-dive on KV eviction behavior and whether kernel OOM/disk pressure contributed.
Jordan (oncall): handing off monitoring and final notes to Priya. I'm offline after 30m. Please escalate to me if errors rebound.
Priya: noted. I'll do the initial triage follow-up and collect logs from gen-srv-2.
Miguel: action items summary (assignments):
- Postmortem writeup + timeline: Priya
- KV cache behaviour RCA: Samir
- Runbook & pre-rollout checks: Ava (eng) + Tess (tester)
- Auto-rollback policy for model splits: Tess
- Add synthetic test for kvcache expiry to CI: Jordan (oncall)
Please add estimates and link tasks to the incident board.
Tess: I'll schedule the brown-bag: "Mitigation patterns: KV cache, batching, and safe rollouts" — proposed Tue 11:00 next week, invite to eng, eng-platform, devex. If that works, I'll post a calendar invite. :calendar:
Priya: also note customers affected: Acme-Corp (ID: C-3310) and FinLytics (ID: C-4492). Support will send status emails.
Jordan (oncall): quick snippets to paste into postmortem timeline:```00:44 UTC - model split rollout started
01:10 UTC - first KV eviction spike observed
01:12 UTC - frontend error increase / support tickets start
01:15 UTC - mitigated by reducing batcher.max_concurrency to 8
01:25 UTC - error rate returns to baseline```
Priya: scheduling postmortem doc + meeting. Please add any notes or screenshots to the doc above.
Ava (eng): will draft runbook changes and add a preflight script: `scripts/preflight_kv_check.sh` to estimate expected KV usage for a variant.
Samir: also adding a metric-based alert for KV eviction rate > 50/min so we catch it before p95 SLO breaks.
Miguel: thanks all. Let's keep this thread for final sign-off once postmortem is published. If anyone needs help with task creation on the incident board ping me. :thumbsup: 
Priya: acknowledged. I'll post the postmortem link + invite once doc is ready.
Jordan (oncall): thanks team — handing off. Good work on the quick mitigation.
ops-bot: Incident marked "mitigated" by Jordan at 2026-03-15T02:05Z. Reminder: please complete postmortem template within 72 hours.
Priya: will do. Brown-bag invite going out shortly.
Tess: RSVP'd.
Ava (eng): adding runbook PR draft now.
Samir: starting RCA deep-dive, will post initial findings in the doc by EOD.
Miguel: closing loop: once postmortem is published we'll run a 30m retro in the brown-bag to extract prevention patterns.
Priya: thanks everyone.
